description: Governor's Secretariat - Central Province - Under Article 154 (C) of the 13th Amendment
categorisation: This gazette notification describes a structural/administrative change to government organization without naming specific individuals. It transfers the Department of Provincial Engineering Services from the Chief Ministry & Ministry of Education to the Chief Secretariat - Central Province, and outlines the subjects before and after the amendment. While the Governor's name appears in the signature, this is a formal requirement and the content itself focuses exclusively on organizational restructuring and portfolio assignments without detailing any individual's specific responsibilities or making personnel appointments.
